from types import SimpleNamespace

from libqtile.layout.tree import TreeTab


class DummyTreeWin:
    def __init__(self, name: str):
        self.name = name
        self.urgent = False

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"DummyTreeWin({self.name})"


class TestTreeTabIndirectGetNextWindowLoopStateQA:
    def test_treetab_indirect_get_next_window_loop_state_case(self):
        focus_events: list[tuple[str, bool]] = []

        layout = TreeTab(sections=["Main"])
        layout._group = SimpleNamespace(
            focus=lambda win, warp: focus_events.append((win.name, warp))
        )

        windows = {ch: DummyTreeWin(ch) for ch in "ABCDEFGHIJ"}
        for ch in "ABCDEFGHIJ":
            layout.add_client(windows[ch])

        # Build a non-trivial tree shape through command chaining.
        operations = [
            ("B", "move_right"),
            ("I", "move_right"),
            ("H", "move_right"),
            ("J", "move_right"),
            ("C", "move_down"),
            ("B", "move_up"),
            ("F", "move_down"),
            ("C", "move_left"),
        ]

        for win_name, command in operations:
            layout.focus(windows[win_name])
            getattr(layout, command)()

        # Indirect chain: TreeTab.next() -> TreeNode.get_next_window().
        layout.focus(windows["J"])
        layout.next()

        assert layout._focused is windows["F"]
        assert focus_events[-1] == ("F", False)

from types import SimpleNamespace
from libqtile.layout.tree import TreeTab, Root

class DummyTreeWin:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name=name
        self.urgent=False
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"W({self.name})"

layout = TreeTab(sections=["Main"])
layout._group = SimpleNamespace(focus=lambda win, warp: None)
windows={ch: DummyTreeWin(ch) for ch in 'ABCDEFGHIJ'}
for ch in 'ABCDEFGHIJ':
    layout.add_client(windows[ch])
ops=[('B','move_right'),('I','move_right'),('H','move_right'),('J','move_right'),('C','move_down'),('B','move_up'),('F','move_down'),('C','move_left')]
for w,c in ops:
    layout.focus(windows[w])
    getattr(layout,c)()

# print tree for debugging

def dump(node, depth=0):
    from libqtile.layout.tree import Window, Section
    indent='  '*depth
    if isinstance(node, Window):
        print(indent+node.window.name)
    elif isinstance(node, Section):
        print(indent+f"[{node.title}]")
    else:
        print(indent+node.__class__.__name__)
    for ch in node.children:
        dump(ch, depth+1)

dump(layout._tree)

node = layout._nodes[windows['J']]
print('focused J parent', type(node.parent).__name__, [getattr(c,'window',None).name if hasattr(c,'window') else c.title for c in node.parent.children])

# emulate get_next_window with trace
from libqtile.layout.tree import Root

n=node
if n.children and n.expanded:
    print('direct child route')
else:
    while not isinstance(n, Root):
        parent=n.parent
        idx=parent.children.index(n)
        print('at node', getattr(getattr(n,'window',None),'name',type(n).__name__), 'parent', type(parent).__name__, 'idx', idx, 'siblings', [getattr(c,'window',None).name if hasattr(c,'window') else c.title for c in parent.children])
        for i in range(idx+1, len(parent.children)):
            candidate=parent.children[i]
            # calculate first window
            res=candidate.get_first_window()
            print('  i',i,'candidate',getattr(getattr(candidate,'window',None),'name',type(candidate).__name__),'res', getattr(res.window,'name',None) if res else None)
            if res:
                print('RETURN idx,i =', idx, i, 'res',res.window.name)
                raise SystemExit
        n=parent
print('no next window')
